[Intro]

[Verse]
Blessed is the man who walks not in the counsel of the wicked,
    nor stands in the way of sinners,
nor sits in the seat of scoffers,
    but his delight is in the law of the Lord,

[pre-chorus]
and on his law he meditates day and night,
    He is like a tree planted by streams of water that yields its fruit in its season,
and its leaf does not wither,
    In all that he does, he prospers,

[Chorus]
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment,
    nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous,
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment,
    The Way of the Righteous and the Wicked.

[Verse]

    nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous,
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment,
    The Way of the Righteous and the Wicked.

[Bridge | Stripped Back | Intimate]

    but are like chaff that the wind drives away,
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment,
    nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous,

[Breakdown | Building | Full Band]
for the Lord knows the way of the righteous,
    but the way of the wicked will perish,
The wicked are not so,
    but are like chaff that the wind drives away,

[Intro]

[Verse]
Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain,
    The kings of the earth set themselves,
and the rulers take counsel together,
    against the Lord and against his Anointed,

[pre-chorus]
I will tell of the decree : The Lord said to me,
    You are my Son,
today I have begotten you,
    Ask of me, and I will make the nations your heritage,

[Chorus]
lest he be angry,
    and you perish in the way,
lest he be angry,
    The Reign of the Lord ’s Anointed.

[Verse]
Then he will speak to them in his wrath,
    and terrify them in his fury,
saying,
    As for me, I have set my King on Zion, my holy hill,

[pre-chorus]
I will tell of the decree : The Lord said to me,
    You are my Son,
today I have begotten you,
    Ask of me, and I will make the nations your heritage,

[Chorus]
lest he be angry,
    and you perish in the way,
lest he be angry,
    The Reign of the Lord ’s Anointed.

[Bridge | Stripped Back | Intimate]
and the ends of the earth your possession,
    You shall break them with a rod of iron and dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel,
Now therefore, O kings, be wise,
    be warned, O rulers of the earth,

[Breakdown | Building | Full Band]
Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling,
    Kiss the Son,
lest he be angry,
    and you perish in the way,

[Intro]

[Verse]
O Lord, how many are my foes! Many are rising against me,
    many are saying of my soul,
there is no salvation for him in God,
    But you, O Lord,

[pre-chorus]
my glory, and the lifter of my head,
    I cried aloud to the Lord,
and he answered me from his holy hill,
    I lay down and slept,

[Chorus]
O my God! For you strike all my enemies on the cheek,
    you break the teeth of the wicked,
O my God! For you strike all my enemies on the cheek,
    Save Me, O My God.

[Verse]
my glory, and the lifter of my head,
    I cried aloud to the Lord,

I will not be afraid of many thousands of people who have set themselves against me all around,

O my God! For you strike all my enemies on the cheek,

[Breakdown | Building | Full Band]
Salvation belongs to the Lord,
    your blessing be on your people,

    Arise, O Lord! Save me,

[Intro]

[Verse]
Answer me when I call,
    O God of my righteousness! You have given me relief when I was in distress,
Be gracious to me and hear my prayer,
    O men, how long shall my honor be turned into shame? How long will you love vain words and seek after lies,

[pre-chorus]
the Lord hears when I call to him,
    Be angry, and do not sin,
ponder in your own hearts on your beds, and be silent,
    Offer right sacrifices, and put your trust in the Lord,

[Chorus]
O Lord,
    You have put more joy in my heart than they have when their grain and wine abound,
O Lord,
    Answer Me When I Call.

O Lord,

[Intro]

[Verse]
Give ear to my words, O Lord,
    consider my groaning,
Give attention to the sound of my cry,
    my King and my God,

[pre-chorus]
I will bow down toward your holy temple in the fear of you,
    Lead me, O Lord,
in your righteousness because of my enemies,
    make your way straight before me,

[Chorus]
and spread your protection over them,
    that those who love your name may exult in you,
and spread your protection over them,
    Lead Me in Your Righteousness.

[Verse]

in your righteousness because of my enemies,

[Chorus]
and spread your protection over them,

and spread your protection over them,

let them fall by their own counsels,
    because of the abundance of their transgressions cast them out,

[Breakdown | Building | Full Band]

    But let all who take refuge in you rejoice,
let them ever sing for joy,
    and spread your protection over them,

[Intro]

[Verse]
O Lord, rebuke me not in your anger,
    nor discipline me in your wrath,
Be gracious to me, O Lord, for I am languishing,
    heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled,

[pre-chorus]
save me for the sake of your steadfast love,
    For in death there is no remembrance of you,
in Sheol who will give you praise,
    I am weary with my moaning,

[Chorus]
The Lord has heard my plea,
    the Lord accepts my prayer,

all you workers of evil,

[Intro]

[Verse]
O Lord my God, in you do I take refuge,
    save me from all my pursuers and deliver me,
lest like a lion they tear my soul apart,
    rending it in pieces,

[pre-chorus]
The Lord judges the peoples,
    judge me, O Lord,
according to my righteousness and according to the integrity that is in me,
    Oh, let the evil of the wicked come to an end,

[Chorus]
and on his own skull his violence descends,
    I will give to the Lord the thanks due to his righteousness,
and on his own skull his violence descends,

awake for me,

    He makes a pit,
digging it out,

[Intro]

[Verse]
O Lord, our Lord,

Out of the mouth of babies and infants,

[pre-chorus]
the work of your fingers,

[Chorus]
and the fish of the sea,

[Verse]
I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart,

that I may recount all your praises,

their own foot has been caught,

he has executed judgment,

Know that the Lord,

! O Lord my God,

oil to make his face shine and bread to strengthen man’s heart,
